div.p: How we handle the data you submit through the website forms.

This page explains how the AKT Group website collects, uses and protects the data you submit through its forms: the contact form, quotation requests, site-visit and call requests, supplier and subcontractor registration, and job application and CV forms.

The contact details you enter (name, phone number, email address); the details of your request or project; your company details when registering as a supplier or subcontractor; and your CV and any files you choose to attach to your request.

We use the data to respond to your enquiry, review your quotation or visit request, evaluate supplier and subcontractor registrations, and review job applications and CVs. We do not use your data for any other purpose without notifying you.
Files you upload (such as your CV or qualification documents) are stored in a protected internal system, and access is limited to the team responsible for reviewing your request.
We do not sell your data and we do not share it with external parties for marketing purposes. Hosting and operations providers may process data only to the extent needed to run the website.
We keep your data for as long as needed to handle your request, or as required by applicable legal and regulatory obligations.
The website uses only the essential cookies required to operate sessions and security features. It does not use advertising trackers.
We apply technical and organisational measures to protect submitted data, and access to the admin panel is restricted to authorised staff.
You can ask to view, correct or delete your data by contacting us through the contact details shown on the website.
We may update this page when needed. Last updated: November 2026.
For privacy questions, reach us by phone or email using the details at the bottom of this page.
